subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second, higher-precedence bootstrap instruction source, or should workspace remain the sole authority with warnings for misplaced files?
rationale: Both choices are technically implementable, but they define persistent prompt precedence, upgrade behavior, backup expectations, and the trust boundary around per-agent runtime state.

options.title: Keep workspace authoritative
options.body: Preserve the existing workspace contract and use the warning-and-documentation path represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653.

options.title: Adopt agentDir overrides
options.body: Explicitly approve the new precedence, align docs and management surfaces, and require fresh-install plus upgrade proof across interactive, heartbeat, and cron runs.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace authoritative
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing workspace contract and use the warning-and-documentation path represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged bootstrap routing work most directly established workspace truth and the run-mode invariants affected by this choice.
